findings.detail: The standardization paragraph contains an inline '[IFCC C-STFT website]' reference that is not numbered and has no corresponding bibliography entry. The IFCC C-STFT is an admissible Tier-2 source (ifcc.org is whitelisted), but the citation is unbibliographed and untagged. This does not affect any numbered entry's resolution — entries [1]–[8] all resolve correctly with matching mechanism_review tags — but the orphaned prose reference breaks strict bibliography completeness. Downstream automated bib parsing will miss this claim.

summary: Both prior defects are confirmed fixed: all eight inline citations now use the required mechanism_review enum (zero descriptive slugs, zero bare [N]), and reference [3] is now Lin 2024 (ADLM scientific short on T3 utility) rather than the duplicated Welsh & Soldin entry — bibliography is contiguous 1–8 with no gaps or orphans. The single residual minor finding is an unnumbered '[IFCC C-STFT website]' prose reference in the standardization section that lacks a bib entry and tag; it cites an admissible whitelisted host but is outside the numbered citation system. All other dimensions are strong: concentration challenge framed quantitatively, interference directions mechanistically justified, NTIS deiodinase mechanism correct with rT3-not-universal nuance, and section covers every brief-required element. Total 95 clears the 92 threshold.
